title: SecureDrop
tagline: A Ledger device minimal installer, designed to help people secure their assets
description:
When people get an airdrop, there's a chance they’ll lose it because of a scam.

This project is a security workshop designed to allow users to install an Ethereum app on their Ledger device in a minimal way.

The goal is to help people secure their assets in a simpler way, without having to install heavy software.
how_its_made:
This project uses the ledger-live CLI and the Ethereum app. It doesn't use the Device Management Toolkit because it lacks a few functions at the moment, but another version might work in a few months.

The goal is to make a working installer, very lightweight, so people can just download it.
